notes.title: We added a lot of new things to the game!
notes.notes:
[b] Friends, hello everyone! [/ b]
We keep improving our game!
We added a new character to the game, slightly changed the ending "added a piece of history after the final scene, it sheds light on the future of the protagonist."
Bugs and errors have been fixed.
We are gradually introducing the possibility of free movement around the map.
A lot of cosmetic changes.
Everything to make you like the game more and more! We try our best for you.
